tasks.goal: Greet the bookseller and state your purpose
tasks.hint: State your main purpose clearly upon arrival.
tasks.done_when: Learner greeted the bookseller and stated purpose.

tasks.goal: Ask for recommendations in mystery or historical fiction
tasks.hint: State your preferred reading genre to the bookseller.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for mystery or historical fiction recommendations.

tasks.goal: Inquire about current store bestseller list titles
tasks.hint: Ask which popular new releases are highly recommended.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about store bestseller titles.

tasks.goal: Ask if a specific author's latest novel is in stock
tasks.hint: Check availability of a particular book title or writer.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for availability of a specific book.
tasks.scene_hint: Faint aroma of freshly brewed espresso mixes with old paper and polished wood.

tasks.goal: Ask whether softcover paperback edition is available
tasks.hint: Inquire if a cheaper paperback version exists instead of hardcover.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about paperback edition availability.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'chapter'
tasks.hint: Chapter is a book division. Ask how many chapters are in the novel.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'chapter'.

tasks.goal: Request a brief plot summary without major spoilers
tasks.hint: Ask the bookseller what the book is about.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for a non-spoiler book synopsis.

tasks.goal: Negotiate a discount on a damaged book copy with creased pages
tasks.hint: Ask for a price reduction on a slightly worn display copy.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested a discount on a damaged book.

tasks.goal: Ask if the bookstore hosts monthly author signing events
tasks.hint: Inquire about literary events and reading clubs.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about book club or author signing events.

tasks.goal: Politely request an alternative after finding the first suggestion unappealing
tasks.hint: Explain why a recommended book doesn't fit your taste.
tasks.done_when: Learner expressed dissatisfaction with suggestion and asked for another.
tasks.scene_hint: Raindrops patter gently against leaded glass window panes above cozy armchairs.

tasks.goal: Ask if out-of-stock books can be special ordered
tasks.hint: Inquire how long special orders take to arrive.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about special ordering out-of-stock titles.

tasks.goal: Inquire about store loyalty reward card signup
tasks.hint: Ask if buying books earns rewards points.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about bookstore loyalty program.

tasks.goal: Request decorative gift wrapping for a hardcover purchase
tasks.hint: Ask to have the book wrapped as a gift.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested gift wrapping service.

tasks.goal: Confirm payment and ask for a bookmark with receipt
tasks.hint: Complete transaction and ask for a complimentary bookmark.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed payment and requested a bookmark.

tasks.goal: Thank the bookseller and bid farewell
tasks.hint: Express gratitude and close the conversation.
tasks.done_when: Learner thanked the bookseller AND said goodbye.

tasks.goal: Specify preferred genre such as historical fiction or sci-fi
tasks.hint: State reading preferences to bookseller.
tasks.done_when: Learner specified preferred literary genre.

tasks.goal: Ask for recommendations of recent bestselling fiction titles
tasks.hint: Ask bookseller what popular novels came out this month.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for recent bestselling fiction recommendations.

tasks.goal: Inquire if book is available in audiobook or ebook format
tasks.hint: Ask if digital versions exist for recommended title.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about audiobook or ebook availability.

tasks.goal: Inquire about special ordering out-of-stock imported books
tasks.hint: Ask if store can order title from overseas publisher.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about special ordering out-of-stock books.

tasks.goal: Confirm store loyalty member program discount benefits
tasks.hint: Ask how points are earned on book purchases.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired about store loyalty rewards program benefits.

tasks.goal: Inquire if the bookstore offers domestic shipping for gift purchases
tasks.hint: Ask if the store can mail a purchased book directly to a friend.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired about domestic shipping options for gift books.

tasks.goal: Request complimentary gift wrapping for hardcover book purchase
tasks.hint: Ask bookseller to wrap book in gift paper.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested gift wrapping for book purchase.

tasks.goal: Verify store return policy for unread books with receipt
tasks.hint: Ask within how many days unread books can be exchanged.
tasks.done_when: Learner verified book exchange and return policy.

tasks.goal: Confirm location of store cafe and reading lounge area
tasks.hint: Ask where customer seating and coffee bar are located.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for location of bookstore cafe and reading lounge.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'anthology'
tasks.hint: Anthology is collection of literary works. Ask for short story anthology recommendations.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'anthology'.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'memoir'
tasks.hint: Memoir is biographical writing. Ask for recommendations on historical memoirs.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'memoir'.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'hardcover'
tasks.hint: Hardcover is bound with rigid covers. Ask if book is available in hardcover.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'hardcover'.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'bibliography'
tasks.hint: Bibliography lists source references. Ask if academic book contains full bibliography.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'bibliography'.

tasks.goal: Inquire about translated fiction works from Japanese authors
tasks.hint: Ask bookseller for translated international literature.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for recommendations on translated fiction.

tasks.goal: Ask if bookstore carries rare out-of-print first edition titles
tasks.hint: Inquire if collectible book section exists.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about rare out-of-print first edition books.

tasks.goal: Report misprinted pages or upside-down binding in novel
tasks.hint: Point out publishing print defect in display copy.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported printing defect in book copy.

tasks.goal: Request recommendation for gripping page-turner mystery novel
tasks.hint: Describe wanting suspenseful fast-paced thriller book.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested suspense mystery novel recommendation.
tasks.scene_hint: Warm scent of freshly brewed espresso and old paper filling store.

tasks.goal: Ask for clarification regarding local author showcase section
tasks.hint: Ask where books by regional writers are shelved.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about local author book section location.

tasks.goal: Inquire if bookstore offers monthly book subscription box service
tasks.hint: Ask about curated book selection delivery service.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired about monthly book subscription box service.

tasks.goal: Report torn dust jacket on display copy of hardcover
tasks.hint: Inform clerk of damaged cover sleeve before purchasing.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported torn book dust jacket.
tasks.scene_hint: Floor-to-ceiling wooden bookshelves fitted with rolling brass ladders.

tasks.goal: Ask if store carries graphic novels and illustrated comics
tasks.hint: Inquire location of manga and graphic novel section.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about graphic novel and comic selection.

tasks.goal: Request holding reserved copy of new release behind counter
tasks.hint: Ask bookseller to hold copy until tomorrow evening.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested book reservation hold behind counter.

tasks.goal: Inquire about children picture books with interactive flaps
tasks.hint: Ask for toddler book recommendations with tactile elements.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about interactive children picture books.

tasks.goal: Ask for instructions on using store computer search terminal
tasks.hint: Ask clerk how to search book availability on kiosk.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked how to use store computer search terminal.
tasks.scene_hint: Soft rustle of turned pages in quiet corner reading alcove.

tasks.goal: Clarify policy on reading books without purchasing in cafe
tasks.hint: Ask if browsing unpurchased books while drinking coffee is allowed.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about cafe reading rules for unpurchased books.

tasks.goal: Inquire if bookstore accepts school teacher discount cards
tasks.hint: Ask if educators receive percentage discount on class books.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about teacher and educator discount options.

tasks.goal: Ask if poetry collections by contemporary poets are stocked
tasks.hint: Inquire where modern poetry books are located.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about contemporary poetry book section.

tasks.goal: Request assistance reaching high shelf book using step stool
tasks.hint: Ask bookseller to retrieve book from top shelf.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested help reaching book on high shelf.
tasks.scene_hint: Stained glass lamps cast warm amber light on wooden study tables.

tasks.goal: Inquire about literary magazine and journal subscriptions
tasks.hint: Ask if store carries quarterly literary periodicals.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about literary magazine availability.

tasks.goal: Report bent corners on paperback copy on display table
tasks.hint: Inform bookseller of creased cover on new release book.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported bent cover corners on paperback book.

tasks.goal: Confirm whether book club discount applies to monthly selected title
tasks.hint: Ask if featured book club pick is discounted 20 percent.
tasks.done_when: Learner verified book club monthly pick discount.
tasks.scene_hint: Small handwritten staff recommendation cards tucked into book covers.

tasks.goal: Ask if store sells bookmark accessories and reading lights
tasks.hint: Inquire where clip-on book lights are displayed.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about bookmarks and reading accessory merchandise.

tasks.goal: Request recommendations for beginner self-study philosophy books
tasks.hint: Ask bookseller for accessible introduction to philosophy.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested introduction to philosophy book recommendations.

tasks.goal: Inquire about historical atlas and map collection books
tasks.hint: Ask where geographical reference books are shelved.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about historical atlas and map books.

tasks.goal: Ask if store credit can be redeemed for cafe purchases
tasks.hint: Inquire if book merchandise voucher pays for coffee.

tasks.goal: Report duplicate chapter printed in middle of textbook
tasks.hint: Inform clerk that pages jump from chapter three to five.

tasks.scene_hint: Gentle acoustic guitar music playing quietly over store speakers.

tasks.goal: Ask for recommendation on inspiring biography of female scientist
tasks.hint: Inquire about biographical books focusing on scientific figures.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested biography of female scientist recommendation.

tasks.goal: Request store map showing foreign language section location
tasks.hint: Ask bookseller where Spanish and French books are located.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested directions to foreign language book section.
tasks.scene_hint: Piles of colorful children storybooks arranged on low circular tables.

tasks.goal: Confirm whether ebook version includes bonus author interview
tasks.hint: Ask about exclusive digital content included with ebook.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about bonus content in digital ebook edition.

tasks.goal: Ask if bookstore hosts weekly children storytime hour
tasks.hint: Inquire what day and time kids reading sessions occur.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about children weekly storytime schedule.

tasks.goal: Inquire about leather-bound classic literature collector editions
tasks.hint: Ask where deluxe gift editions of classic novels are kept.

tasks.goal: Report missing CD disk from language learning textbook
tasks.hint: Inform clerk that accompanying audio disk is missing from pouch.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported missing audio CD from textbook.
tasks.scene_hint: Canvas tote bags printed with literary quotes hanging on display rack.

tasks.goal: Ask if store sells gift voucher certificates for online redemption
tasks.hint: Inquire if gift card works on store website.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if gift cards are valid for web purchases.

tasks.goal: Inquire about creative writing workshop classes held at bookstore
tasks.hint: Ask if writing seminars are open for public registration.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about creative writing workshops at bookstore.

tasks.goal: Request extra paper shopping bag with sturdy handles
tasks.hint: Ask bookseller for additional bag for heavy hardcovers.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested sturdy shopping bag for books.
tasks.scene_hint: Row of vintage book presses displayed near storefront window.

tasks.goal: Ask about policy on returning opened audiobook CD sets
tasks.hint: Inquire if audiobooks can be returned if disk is scratched.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about return policy for opened audiobook sets.

tasks.goal: Clarify procedure for submitting self-published book for consignment sale
tasks.hint: Ask how local authors list books on store shelves.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about author consignment submission guidelines.

tasks.goal: Inquire about environmental recycled paper policies of publisher
tasks.hint: Ask if publisher uses eco-friendly forest certified paper.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about eco-friendly paper sourcing in publishing.

tasks.goal: Report sticky price sticker residue on glossy book jacket

tasks.scene_hint: Brass bell above front door tinkles as customers enter bookstore.

tasks.goal: Ask if bookstore carries art exhibition catalogs from museums
tasks.hint: Inquire where fine art and photography monographs are kept.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about museum art exhibition catalogs.

tasks.goal: Request recommendation for lighthearted feel-good beach read

tasks.goal: Inquire about young adult fantasy series order sequence

tasks.scene_hint: Cozy fireplace hearth crackling in rear room of antique book department.

tasks.goal: Ask if store offers student textbook buyback service at semester end

tasks.done_when: Learner asked about textbook buyback program details.

tasks.goal: Request assistance finding book listed as in-stock on computer screen
tasks.hint: Ask bookseller to help locate book missing from shelf spot.
